item.title: Operation No Compromise Leads to 13 Arrests in Muscogee County
item.description: During the 18 search warrants, approximately 2.2 pounds of suspected Cocaine, approximately 46 grams of suspected Fentanyl, approximately 2.5 pounds of suspected Marijuana, approximately 105 grams of suspected THC, approximately 101 suspected Hydrocodone Pills, and other assorted pills and drugs were seized. The total value of the drugs seized was $126,321.00. The MCSO also seized $101,035.12 in U.S. currency and 14 vehicles. The post Operation No Compromise Leads to 13 Arrests in Muscogee Count

item.title: Felon who robbed a Fort Oglethorpe restaurant sentenced to 11 years in prison
item.description: Mario Merriweather, a repeat offender with a 30-year criminal history, has been sentenced to federal prison for robbing a fast-food restaurant in Fort Oglethorpe, Georgia and forcing restaurant staff into a walk-in freezer. The post Felon who robbed a Fort Oglethorpe restaurant sentenced to 11 years in prison appeared first on AllOnGeorgia.

item.title: New Home Construction Slows in 2025, But Still Posts Third Best Year on Record in Walker County
item.description: New home construction in unincorporated Walker County slowed last year, as the cost of construction drove new home prices higher. Still, 2025 ranked as the third best year on record for the county, despite an 11% decline from the previous year. The post New Home Construction Slows in 2025, But Still Posts Third Best Year on Record in Walker County appeared first on AllOnGeorgia.
